evidence.quote: Stuart Houlton Partner and Head of Trading Stuart joined Trinity Street in 2017 to lead the trading team. He was previously at Eton Park for almost 12 years from 2005, including serving as Head of European Trading where he was responsible for all execution across Europe. Prior to Eton Park he worked at Merrill Lynch from 2002 as a European Market Maker in a variety of sectors, and at Morgan Stanley from 1995. Stuart holds a degree in Money, Banking and Finance from the University of Birmingham.
